name: Sakura no Mau Koro ni
source:
Here comes a season when cherry blossoms dance. The air is filled with excitement during entrance ceremony. Acquaintances with girls and sudden confession await main character.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-november-2006-haruka-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
又到了樱花飞舞的季节。入学典礼令空气中充满兴奋与期待。等待主人公的，将是与少女们的相识，以及一场突如其来的告白。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-november-2006-haruka-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
